whyItMatters: redirect redirects python users to a computed address, so untrusted input in the target enables phishing.
actions: Validate the target with url_has_allowed_host_and_scheme check, allowing only relative paths or listed hosts.
Drop untrusted redirect parameters in favor of fixed destinations.
Re-run the scan and confirm no open target remains.
verification: Rescan shows no open redirect, and hostile targets are rejected.
